mapper.sql: select fdr.id, fdr.user_id, fdr.user_name, IFNULL((select real_name from auth_info where user_id = fdr.user_id and del_flag = '0' and `auth_status` = '5' order by auth_time desc limit 1),su.`nick_name` )as nick_name, fdr.task_id,ft.task_name,fdr.file_task_id, fdr.file_task_name, fdr.file_name, fdr.download_time, fdr.del_flag, fdr.create_by, fdr.create_time, fdr.update_by, fdr.update_time, fdr.remark from file_download_record fdr LEFT JOIN file_task ft ON ft.id = fdr.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON fdr.user_id = su.user_id
